metadata.issueBody:
## Summary

leftover(#5791): pre-PR lint_iteration command hardcodes vitest coverage

## Problem

Even after #5791 `coverageMode` lets `coverage_headroom` / `coverage:hotspots` take authorized mode-based N/A, the prescribed pre-PR phase `lint_iteration` is pinned to `vitest run --coverage <changed-paths>` (`packages/core/src/pre-pr-controller/phases.ts`).

No-suite and non-Vitest consumers (including xUnit) still cannot complete the full prescribed pre-PR controller pass: hotspots may N/A while lint_iteration remains a Vitest-shaped required observation.

Called out in Round-1 Codex on #5791 (comment 6327448171): a hotspots-only unit test cannot establish end-to-end relief for the OVPR pin/lock fixture.

## What to build

- Mode- or toolchain-aware disposition for `lint_iteration` when coverage enforcement is not `full` / when no Vitest suite exists — authorized skip with closed reason, or provider-shaped command observation.
- Align with #5791 `coverageMode` and any future coverage provider leftover; do not invent a second unrelated posture enum if one shared resolver suffices.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Framework-only / no-suite pin upgrade can complete full `deft pre-pr:run` under `coverageMode: initial|disabled` without inventing a Vitest suite.
- [ ] `full` + Vitest path unchanged.
- [ ] Skip/admission stays Prefer-A honest (non-zero + closed reason; controller re-derive/re-read).

## Keep-outs

- Do not absorb non-Istanbul measurement adapters here (sibling leftover).
- Do not remove lint_iteration as a required phase without a Bound.

Parent: deftai/directive#5791 Prefer-A Bound 6327510671. Round-1 Codex 6327448171.
